videos.motivation: Closed dark lid with a cool fluorescent streak is the listing-condition photo this surface actually publishes. A 6s 720p pan along that streak moves the indoor light without adding a new scene.
Wide open-laptop still on a wooden desk with a sunset photograph on the display matches the typical search-result hero. Slow push-in keeps the amateur indoor light and blank chassis.
A hand holding a closed unmarked lid on a dark wood table is the seller-proof gesture in the sampled listings. Slight handheld drift is the only motion that still belongs to that photo.
